_: How to watch a network from Cancún, for the live game block (app.js renderTeamLive). Keys are regexes matched against the broadcast names a game carries (ESPN's, or channels.json clubs), case-insensitive; first match wins. The US template rows were replaced 2026-10-31. ota = the Cancún over-the-air station and its virtual channel (Mexico's virtual numbers are national; call signs from Wikipedia's list of Quintana Roo stations, which cites the IFT); stream = the services that carry it in Mexico (ViX for TUDN, Disney+ for ESPN). paytv = the channel number on each pay-TV provider (app.js prints "Izzi 890" etc. after the over-the-air line), from Selectra's provider pages checked 2026-09-08/10 plus GatoTV and InternetEnCasa for Izzi (read 2026-11-01); the providers' own guides answered bot walls, so these are third-party figures. Izzi's numbering is national (only locals vary by city) and its sports numbers conflict between sources (ESPN 508 or 896, ESPN 3 510 or 897), so Izzi has no ESPN numbers; Sky's numbers are its single 1xxx HD numbers; Totalplay's locals are the Cancún feeds (1xx is the national one) and it has carried no TUDN since 2024-12. Megacable also serves Cancún but was not asked for. Neither ESPN's mex.2 feed nor the LMB's statsapi schedule names broadcasters (checked 2026-10-31), so these rows only fire through clubs or future listings. A streaming-only service lists just its name.

links._: Where each name in the strip goes (app.js buildWatchList links an entry to the longest name it contains).

_hide: An entry with hide: true is a feed no Cancún viewer can use (Canadian regional and national feeds from the template): the strip leaves it out.

clubs._: What every game of a club carries beyond the league's listing (app.js buildWatchStrip adds them when the game's own list lacks them).
